label: prf:descent
title: Proof of Descent preserves the quantum observable universe
html:
Proof. Proof of Descent preserves the quantum observable universe

The proof mirrors the ascent (jet prolongation) in reverse, working inside \mathbf{C}.

Step 1: Frobenius restriction. The jet object J^1(A) = A \otimes \Omega^1(A) at level n contains A as a direct summand via the unit section \eta \otimes \mathrm{id}\colon \Omega^1(A) \hookrightarrow A \otimes \Omega^1(A). Composing with the counit \varepsilon\colon A \to \mathbf{1} on the first tensor factor gives the restriction map r_n\colon J^1(A) \to A. Because A is Frobenius, r_n is a coalgebra morphism --- \Delta commutes with restriction by the Frobenius relation, and the counit restricts by construction --- so the restricted object inherits a Frobenius--Hopf structure.

Step 2: Connection restriction. The connection A_n on \mathcal{S}_n is determined by the comultiplication \Delta' on J^1(A) (jet prolongation, Step 2). Restricting \Delta' along r_n recovers the original \Delta on A, which corresponds to the connection A_{n-1} on \mathcal{S}_{n-1}. Hence A_{n-1} satisfies the Hermitian Yang--Mills equations on \mathcal{S}_{n-1} as it did at level n{-}1.

Step 3: Non-degeneracy and vanishing. Non-degeneracy of the Frobenius form on the restricted object follows from the direct-summand inclusion A \hookrightarrow J^1(A). The vanishing condition \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 is unchanged since we recover A.

Step 4: The descent homomorphism. Applying \tau to r_n yields \mathfrak{d}_n\colon \Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)) \to \Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_{n-1}, \mathrm{SU}_{q_{n-1}}(2)), a *-homomorphism because r_n preserves multiplication and antipode. Surjectivity follows from the injectivity of the ascent map \ell_n (it embeds A into J^1(A) as a direct summand), so its categorical adjoint r_n is surjective.

Step 5: Equivariance. The \mathrm{SU}(2)-action on sections at level n is the adjoint representation of the Hopf algebra; since r_n is a Hopf algebra morphism, it intertwines the adjoint actions at levels n and n{-}1. \square
